The spell that

The magic
that might bring,
eternal

[Verse 1]
[A#m]I see a
world in anger,
[F#]I see a
world in pain.
[A#m]Each day a
different story,
[F#]but still the
message is the same.
[A#m]Hard news I
set beside me,
[F#]sweet dreams is
what I need.
[A#m]What daylight
wants to show me,
[F#]at night ap-
pears to be in-

[F#]sane! [C#]
[D#m][F#]May I

[F#]Shall [C#]

[A#m]

[A#m]My cards, the

[F#]the role they
play tonight.
[A#m]Which ones em-
brace their loved ones?
[F#]Which ones will
summon for a fight?
[A#m]Show me your
precious darling
[F#]and I will
crush them all.
[A#m]Wave with your
blooded sword and
[F#]I'll kiss to
show I'm not a-
